Script.name: goals
Script.script:
--[[ Goals — what you're saving up for Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
Set a target, and this tells you the moment you can afford it.
Written against Aardwolf's gmcp.char.worth, not against anyone's plugin. Hadar's Goal Tracker showed the idea was worth having; the design here is our own and shares nothing with it - see CREDITS.md.
The one thing worth doing differently: Hadar's version told you where you stood when you asked it. This one watches char.worth and speaks up the moment a goal is met, once, and then shuts up about it. Finding out you can afford the thing is the entire point, and having to remember to ask defeats it. ]]
aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.goals = aardkit.goals or {}
local G = aardkit.goals local U = aardkit.util.named("Goals")
-- Aardwolf's own currencies, as gmcp.char.worth reports them. -- alias -> {gmcp field, display} local KIND = { qp = { "qp", "qp" }, tp = { "tp", "tp" }, gold = { "gold", "gold" }, bank = { "bank", "bank" }, trains = { "trains", "trains" }, pracs = { "pracs", "pracs" }, } -- the short forms people actually type local ALIAS = { quest = "qp", qps = "qp", tps = "tp", trivia = "tp", train = "trains", prac = "pracs", coins = "gold", banked = "bank", }
local ORDER = { "qp", "tp", "gold", "bank", "trains", "pracs" }
local CFG = U.load("goals", { channel = "echo", goals = {} }) CFG.goals = CFG.goals or {}
local function save() U.save("goals", CFG) end
local function kind_of(word) word = (word or ""):lower() word = ALIAS[word] or word return KIND[word] and word or nil end
-- what you're holding right now local function held() local w = (gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.worth) or {} local out = {} for k, spec in pairs(KIND) do out[k] = tonumber(w[spec[1]]) or 0 end return out end
--- -- progress ---
local BAR_W = 20
local function bar(pct) local full = math.floor(BAR_W * math.min(pct, 100) / 100 + 0.5) local colour = pct >= 100 and "#3ad07a" or (pct >= 50 and "#e0af68" or "#7aa2f7") return "<" .. colour .. ">" .. string.rep("=", full) .. "<#3a4a6b>" .. string.rep("-", BAR_W - full) .. "<r>" end
-- one goal against current holdings. Capped at 100: "140% of the way there" -- isn't a thing, you either have it or you don't. local function progress(g, have) local pct = g.want > 0 and math.floor(have / g.want * 100 + 0.5) or 100 return math.min(100, pct), math.max(0, g.want - have) end
--- -- the watcher — the reason this exists ---
function G.on_worth() local have = held() local newly = {}
for name, g in pairs(CFG.goals) do local got = have[g.kind] or 0 if got >= g.want then if not g.hit then g.hit = true newly[#newly + 1] = { name = name, g = g } end elseif g.hit then -- dropped back below (spent it); re-arm so it announces again later g.hit = false end end
if #newly > 0 then save() for _, n in ipairs(newly) do local line = string.format("%s is within reach - %s %s", n.name, U.commas(n.g.want), KIND[n.g.kind][2]) if CFG.channel == "echo" then U.ok(line) else send(CFG.channel .. " " .. line, false) end end end end
--- -- display ---
local function show(filter) local names = {} for n in pairs(CFG.goals) do names[#names + 1] = n end
if #names == 0 then U.note("No goals. Set one with: goal add <name> <amount> [type]") return end
local have = held() local rows = {} for _, n in ipairs(names) do local g = CFG.goals[n] if not filter or filter == g.kind then local pct, left = progress(g, have[g.kind] or 0) rows[#rows + 1] = { name = n, g = g, pct = pct, left = left } end end
if #rows == 0 then U.note("No goals of type '" .. tostring(filter) .. "'.") return end
-- closest to done first; that's the one you care about table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a.pct ~= b.pct then return a.pct > b.pct end return a.name < b.name end)
local w = 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do w = math.max(w, #r.name) end
U.out("\n<#7aa2f7>Goals<r>") for _, r in ipairs(rows) do U.out(string.format("\n <#c8d0dc>%-" .. w .. "s<r> %s <#c8d0dc>%3d%%<r>", r.name, bar(r.pct), r.pct)) if r.pct >= 100 then U.out(string.format(" <#3ad07a>have it<r>")) else U.out(string.format(" <#8a93a8>%s %s to go<r>", U.commas(r.left), KIND[r.g.kind][2])) end end echo("\n") end
-- push the current state to a channel, for grouping local function report() local have = held() local best, bestpct = nil, -1 for n, g in pairs(CFG.goals) do local pct = select(1, progress(g, have[g.kind] or 0)) if pct > bestpct and pct < 100 then best, bestpct = { n, g }, pct end end if not best then U.note("Nothing outstanding to report.") return end local g = best[2] local left = math.max(0, g.want - (have[g.kind] or 0)) local line = string.format("saving for %s: %s/%s %s (%d%%), %s to go", best[1], U.commas(have[g.kind] or 0), U.commas(g.want), KIND[g.kind][2], bestpct, U.commas(left)) if CFG.channel == "echo" then U.note(line) else send(CFG.channel .. " " .. line, false) U.note("-> " .. CFG.channel .. ": " .. line) end end
--- -- commands ---
function G.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "" or verb == "list" then show(nil)
elseif verb == "add" or verb == "set" then local name, amount, kind = U.trim(rest):match("^(%S+)%s+(%d[%d,]*)%s*(%S*)$") if not name then U.warn("Usage: goal add <name> <amount> [qp|tp|gold|bank|trains|pracs]") return end local want = tonumber((amount:gsub(",", ""))) local k = kind_of(kind ~= "" and kind or "qp") if not k then U.warn("Unknown type '" .. kind .. "'. One of: " .. table.concat(ORDER, " ")) return end local existing = CFG.goals[name] CFG.goals[name] = { want = want, kind = k, hit = false } save() U.ok(string.format("%s %s: %s %s", existing and "Updated" or "Saving for", name, U.commas(want), KIND[k][2])) G.on_worth()
elseif verb == "rm" or verb == "del" or verb == "delete" then local name = U.trim(rest):match("^(%S+)") if name and CFG.goals[name] then CFG.goals[name] = nil save() U.ok("Dropped goal: " .. name) else U.warn("No goal called '" .. tostring(name) .. "'.") end
elseif verb == "clear" then if U.trim(rest):lower() == "yes" then CFG.goals = {} save() U.ok("All goals cleared.") else U.warn("Drops every goal. Confirm with: goal clear yes") end
elseif verb == "report" then report()
elseif verb == "channel" then local c = U.trim(rest):match("^(%S+)") if c then CFG.channel = c save() U.ok("Goal announcements go to: " .. c) else U.note("Goal announcements go to: " .. CFG.channel .. " (goal channel <name|echo>)") end
elseif verb == "worth" then local have = held() local rows = {} for _, k in ipairs(ORDER) do rows[#rows + 1] = { KIND[k][2], U.commas(have[k]) } end U.help("Holding now", rows)
elseif kind_of(verb) then show(kind_of(verb))
else U.help("Goals", { { "goal", "progress on everything, closest first" }, { "goal add <name> <amt> [type]", "start saving for something" }, { "goal rm <name>", "drop it" }, { "goal <type>", "just the qp / gold / trains ones" }, { "goal report", "announce the nearest goal to your channel" }, { "goal channel <name|echo>", "where announcements go" }, { "goal worth", "what you're holding right now" }, { "goal clear yes", "drop everything" }, { "" }, { "types: qp tp gold bank trains pracs" }, { "It watches char.worth and says so the moment a goal is met," }, { "once - you don't have to remember to check." }, }) end end
--- -- boot ---
U.killhandler(aardkit_goals_handler) aardkit.gmcp.watch("goals", "char.worth", "aardkit.goals.on_worth")
aardkit.register("goals", "savings goals, announced when met", G.cmd)
